description: This PHP source file defines the entity class 'BuzzPhoto' for the 'orangehrmBuzzPlugin' plugin. It models the data structure for storing photos related to posts in a social or comment system within the OrangeHRM platform, including properties like photo blob, filename, type, size, dimensions, and relations to posts.
